title: SEES Reports Unusual Activity on Block Arqa
content: Members exploring the upper reaches of Arqa report a spike in Shadow density. Caution advised.

title: Full Moon Operation Scheduled
content: A large Shadow signature has been detected. All available members are to report for the operation.

title: Access to Yabbashah Confirmed
content: The barrier blocking Yabbashah has dissolved. Members may now proceed past the previous limit.

title: Elizabeth Requests New Deliverables
content: The Velvet Room has issued new requests for rare materials and unusual treasures. Prepare for a longer outing.

title: General Announcement: Supply Drop Arrives
content: Medical supplies and support items have been delivered to the dormitory for the next operation window.

title: Tziah Route Survey Completed
content: The latest route survey confirmed a safer corridor through Tziah. Scouts recommend bringing a party with strong magic support.

title: Mission Update: Aigis to Lead Scout Team
content: Aigis has been assigned to the lead scout team for the next expedition into Harabah. Expect stricter route planning and more detailed field reports.

title: Dormitory Notice: Restock Complete
content: Emergency restoratives, antidotes, and new combat gear have arrived at the dormitory after the previous supply delay.
